verdict.rationale: Linear documents an official TypeScript SDK that exposes its GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations. The docs include an install guide and usage code, and the SDK package lives in the official linear/linear repo alongside the published schema. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
